description: This file defines the Customer reporting model class for the OpenCart admin extension. It contains methods for retrieving customer statistics, orders, reward points, activities, searches, and related data from the database. The class enables generating various customer-related reports based on different filters.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Customer report model class providing methods to retrieve various customer statistics and information.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array with total customers for each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts for each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array with total customers for each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array with total customers for each month of the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches customer records based on optional filters like date range, group, start, and limit.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns total count of customer records based on optional filters.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches order details with optional filters such as date range, customer, and order status.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer orders matching optional filters.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Retrieves reward point data for customers, optionally filtered by date range.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns total count of reward point entries based on filters.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Fetches customer activities with optional filters like date range, customer, and IP.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Returns total number of customer activity records matching filters.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Retrieves customer search entries based on filters such as date range, keyword, customer, and IP.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Returns total number of customer search records matching filters.
